author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: These parsers read Webex admin audit events, security audit events and call history. The example bridge in bridges/webex-audit-and-call-history polls them from the Webex APIs and posts them to HTTP Ingest. Security audit events and admin sign-ins and sign-outs go to Auth, and other admin audit events and call records go to CloudAudit.
notes:
Setup:
- Webex audit events and call history are pull only.
- These parsers read what the example bridge in bridges/webex-audit-and-call-history polls from the Webex APIs and posts to HTTP Ingest, with "webex_record" first (admin_audit, security_audit or cdr).
- The admin audit and security audit APIs need the audit:events_read scope authorized by a Full Admin, and sign-ins and sign-outs also need Pro Pack and Allow user authentication data.
- The call history stream needs spark-admin:calling_cdr_read and the Detailed Call History API access permission.

Field mapping:
- Security audit events, and admin audit events in the LOGINS and LOGOUT categories, go to Auth with the user's email, address and user agent; an admin's sign-in has Control Hub as the logon application.
- Webex documents no failure shape for these events, so a description or action text that says "fail" counts as a failure, inferred.
- Other admin audit events go to CloudAudit with the description as the event name, the category as the event type, the admin as the user, the changed resource, and a user target as the target user.
- Categories and target types are read with or without the prefixes of the API's examples.
- Call records have no NG-SIEM schema of their own, and the generic schema keeps only the sensor type, event ID and time.
- Call records go to CloudAudit too: the call type (such as SIP_INTERNATIONAL or SIP_PREMIUM) as the event name, the direction as the event type, the user, the outcome as the status (its reason as the error when it isn't Success) and the device's public address as the source.
- The numbers, country, duration and redirect go to request_parameters; the caller reputation score and result, location, client, trunks and correlation ID to additional_event_data.
- An authorization code stays in original_data, and additional_event_data notes only that one was used.

Time:
- The event time is created for audit events and Start time for calls.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples follow the schemas and examples in Webex's OpenAPI specs with made-up values; the category and description texts other than LOGINS and "An Admin logged in" are made up in that shape.

Testing:
- Each child, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-22 (126 of 126 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs), and the parent's confirm string picked the same records there.
- Each child also passed Run Test as a separate parser under its parent (126 of 126 fields, each line taken in 5 of 5 runs).
- No built-in parser claimed these records.
